youtube_description:
This short video is mostly about our most helpful appliances for our travel and camping trips. That is our Jackery 240 portable power station. It really is indispensable in this day of cell phones  


Use our link to get 15% off on your purchase from Jackery. 

https://jackeryca.refr.cc/referralprogram/u/ruthzipp


We're all too far down the path of AI communication to go back, so, although we love serenity and quiet we do each possess a cell and Mrs, in particular, having 16 direct offspring, we're very connected. 
Going off grid on a trip, means our ‘tether’ will be severed after at the most, 3 or 4 days,  but with a durable power station we extend that greatly. I heard about the Jackery Power Station from a Vancouver (at that time) vlogger who lived in a van. Being a woman with a strong wanderlust I knew the Jackery would enhance my travel. It was a very wise purchase. Since then 2 of my sons have each, also bought one.
I’ve dipped into my photo and video archive here from August of 2022.
